pin_policy: Pin the upstream commits matching the RELEASED build players run, not the tip of `upcoming`. Elite Redux cuts releases from `upcoming` with no tag or release branch. ABILITIES_COUNT is a necessary but NOT sufficient check -- it can hold across a long run of unreleased commits, so do not rely on it alone to pick a SHA. The previous pin (v2.65beta, er-config 123fc66, 2026-03-27) was fixed by direct observation of a real v2.65.3b ROM. The current pin (v2.65.4.1b, the latest release per eliteredux.net, 'Last Updated October 06, 2026') is er-config 7285071 'Movepool fixes' (2026-10-06T17:44:10Z): ER-nextdex built its first 2.65.4 data (ForwardFeed/ER-nextdex 72f001f, 2026-10-06T23:54Z) with its er-config submodule at that commit, and it is the last er-config commit before 2026-10-07T08:20Z. The eliteredux-source SHA f756909 'movepool changes' is the mirror commit made 12s later, as with every prior pair. Not independently confirmed: eliteredux.net gives no timezone or time of day for the release, and nextdex's 2.65.4 data was refreshed on 2026-10-19 from a later commit, so the Oct 6 commit is the best match to the release date, not proof of the build. tests/test_oracle.py asserts ABILITIES_COUNT and species data against ER-nextdex's published (released-game) data -- keep that green when repinning.
